create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab surface from a given Bulk structure
create_slabs_for_specific_millers: create Slab objects for specific Miller indices from a Bulk structure using from_bulk_get_specific_millers
enumerate_all_slabs: enumerate all symmetrically distinct slabs up to a max Miller index using from_bulk_get_all_slabs
tag_and_tile_surface_atoms: tag surface atoms and tile a slab structure to a minimum lateral size using tile_and_tag_atoms
flip_slab_structure: flip a pymatgen Structure object upside down to expose the bottom surface using flip_struct
